rows.label: Dynamic recovery formula
rows.elite: Scale = target / (N × regular interval − sum of burst gaps)
rows.note: Bullet 1 adds regular interval × scale. Later bullets add (regular interval − preceding gap) × scale; negative amounts credit this press only. Existing native cadence is the source.

rows.label: Regular fallback recovery
rows.elite: Continuous recovery; +0.067212 s per fallback shot
rows.note: Fallback fires at a configured 0.148 s interval. From a full depleted burst, ideal regular timing gives 0.836058 s until first full replenishment; native frame scheduling can change this.

rows.label: Recovered reserve availability
rows.note: Reserve available at the start of a press is fixed for that press; holding alt never spends newly recovered rounds.

rows.label: Rapid tap limit
rows.elite: 0.148 s minimum from the last secondary shot
rows.note: New presses use the existing regular interval; blocked shots spawn no projectile/effects and restore native authority-side ammo consumption.

rows.label: Primary-fire recovery
rows.note: Primary spends no burst reserve and adds no burst debt; primary time cannot be reclaimed as later recovery.

notes: Primary damage is 11 at 0.088 s per shot. Secondary base damage is 10 with a sustained 0.148-second interval.
Configured opening: 10 shots over 0.379 game seconds; native frame scheduling can spread the actual shots further apart.
The existing RefillSeconds variable is the 0.50-second full-burst target. Costs derive from the existing FireInterval and cached original native spin-up intervals, before per-press reserve limiting.
Scale = 0.50 / 1.101. Bullet 1 adds 0.067211626 s; bullet 2 credits 0.023614896 s of this press; subsequent shots add proportional debt.
Recovery runs continuously while idle or firing regular fallback, and pauses during primary or accelerated burst firing. Every regular fallback shot adds 0.067211626 s debt.
Recovered reserve becomes usable only after release and a new press. New-press shots cannot bypass the regular 0.148-second interval. Switching never clears debt or the tap deadline.
Missing tick updates catch up using elapsed game time. Native firing is retained; packet-loss synchronization and client rendering are not established by isolated-server tests.

rows.label: Attack interactions (v1.8 policy)
rows.elite: Native projectile predicates govern rocket, Flak and Bio contacts, with reciprocal native Shock-core handling. Default rocket/core and Flak/core pairs remain ignored. Rockets and rocket grenades ignore both Weapon and WeaponNoCharacter traces on main and assist colliders; landed goo uses native shootable collision and native damage response. Other Shock exclusions remain.
rows.note: Contact predicates, component collision and damage response are separate gates.

notes: Ground- and wall-dodge reset delays are 0.01 seconds instead of B19’s 0.35 and 0.20. You still need to complete the relevant movement and satisfy normal ground/wall requirements.

Acceleration is strongest when starting from low speed, then blends toward normal running acceleration. Ground friction affects steering; braking slows you when you release movement input or exceed the speed limit.
Projectile interactions are adjusted to reduce accidental interception between weapons. Server mutators and saved settings can change the defaults shown here.
